chunks: And through its chain, from Ali (peace be upon him), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said:
Hasten to give charity, for whoever hastens with it, the supplication (of that person) will not be rejected.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of hastening to give charity?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (S) emphasizes the virtue of hastening in charity, linking the promptness of the act to the acceptance of supplication. This highlights the Shia scholarly understanding that sincerity and speed in good deeds prevent the 'blocking' of prayers, reinforcing the spiritual efficacy of sadaqah as a means of divine favor.
